caption:
You've never timed your own follow-up.

Here's a test you can run this week. No software needed.

1. Ask a friend, a spouse, or a neighbor, someone who has never called your business before.

2. Have them submit your contact form or call your main line at a random time. Don't tell them when.

3. Time how long it takes to reach a real response, not an auto-reply, the actual first human or booking message.

4. Log the channel: text, call, email, or nothing at all.

Most service businesses take far longer than an hour to respond to a new lead. The ones that respond fast tend to close a lot more of them.

Run the test once this week. Then run it monthly. You can't fix a speed problem you've never measured.
